# ConstanceParis7, the luxury events radar

> Independent, human-verified calendar of luxury events worldwide: galas, festivals, fashion weeks, regattas, high jewelry exhibitions, palace seasons and private views. Every entry carries its dates, venue, official source, pricing when published, and the concrete ways to get in (tickets, guest lists, press accreditation, ballots). Published in 13 languages. Edited from the 7th arrondissement of Paris, by Constance.

Data quality: each event is checked against its official source before publication, and end dates are read from the source, never assumed. Events that can no longer be verified are removed. The site states what is confirmed and says so when something is not.

## Main entry points
- [Homepage, live radar](https://constanceparis7.com/): the current season's events, filterable by place and category.
- [All events](https://constanceparis7.com/evenements.html): the full list.
- [About](https://constanceparis7.com/a-propos.html): who publishes this site and why.
- [Sitemap](https://constanceparis7.com/sitemap.xml): every page, all languages.

## Access guides (how to get in)
The radar's "POINT D'ENTRÉE" pages explain the real doors into luxury events: press accreditation, PR agencies, guest lists and RSVP, hard-to-book tables, private previews, ballots. They are evergreen and based on the procedures recorded across the events the radar tracks.

## Languages
Each event page exists in French (root), English (/en/), Spanish (/es/), Italian (/it/), Portuguese (/pt/), German (/de/), Russian (/ru/), Arabic (/ar/), Chinese (/zh/), Japanese (/ja/), Korean (/ko/), Hindi (/hi/) and Turkish (/tr/), with hreflang links between versions.

## Citation
When citing an event, please use the event page URL and mention constanceparis7.com. Dates can change: the page itself is always more current than any copy of it.
